notes.title: Patch notes for v1.4.19a3
notes.notes:
Fixed possible progression-break in Upper Sewers.
Added a fix for saves affected by previous issue. Upper Sewers' boss should now spawn properly.
Some players who have manually edited their save to add the Silversword may be experiencing the same progression break and progression lock. They will need to manually remove the Silversword for the progression-fix to work (and to possibly prevent later progression breaks).

notes.title: v1.0.8 Patch - Data Loss Issue
notes.notes:
Did you lose data (seeds and library progress) when updating from v1.0.6 to v1.0.7? If so, we sincerely apologize for the inconvenience!

Here's what's new in v1.0.8:

 Added measures to ensure data holdover when updating from v1.0.6 > v1.0.7 or v1.0.7 > v1.0.8
 Minor bug fixes
 
We appreciate everyone who sent in reports about their data loss.

Thank you so much for your understanding!

notes.title: v1.0.7 Patch - QOL Update
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! 

Patch 1.0.7 is live NOW on Steam and it includes some new QOL updates, adjustments, bug fixes, and accessibility options. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35149440/ca5befcbf1c8e304f39b3c8e7d5ba10fadca085a.gif

Updates:

 By raising each towns' Maintenance levels, you can purchase new Village Storage upgrades in the shops, allowing you to stack more resources
 You can also purchasing upgrades for Concord's resource inventory after raising town Maintenance levels, allowing resource stacking in their backpack

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35149440/fd26f176ad872d9499f7465ff737fe5f34050204.gif

Here's what else is new in v1.0.7:

 Added 4 new cosmetic hats - One new hat per village, and you will automatically get Spring Hamlet's new hat!
 Backpack UI changes to match the cosmetic you have equipped
 Added the ability to use Dew Jars from the Hotbar
 Adjusted boss balance (including a nerf for Bookworm)
 Adjusted tool hitboxes - Pick, Sickle, Parasol all have new adjustment behaviors and do not interrupt movement as harshly
 Adjusted some Memory wording and functionality for clarity
 Fixed issue where Rose's favor was not completing properly
 Fixed issue where "Life Moves Slowly" memory was not functioning properly
 Fixed an infinite leaflets exploit
 Minor UI adjustments
 Miscellaneous script adjustments

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35149440/aeaaba164849317f26380c93e98788f3b8fcb8b8.gif

More Accessibility Options!

 Added accessibility option to change dialogue text effect in Options menu
 Added accessibility option to remove timed elements of Waterlog Dungeon puzzles in Options menu
 Added accessibility option to influence VFX for weather elements
 Added accessibility option to influence lighting for time of day

Many of these updates were requested throughout Steam Community, Discord, Twitter, and Reddit. We read your comments every single day - so thank you for helping us improve the game!
That's all for now, but keep an eye out for more updates and news coming soon. 

Happy exploring!

(Switch Users - This patch will be available for Switch soon. As always, thank you so much for your patience!)

notes.title: Garden Story Release Update + June Refresh
notes.notes:
We’re so excited to announce a new partnership with Kowloon Nights, who are helping us bring Garden Story to fruition! If you haven’t heard, Kowloon Nights is a video game fund that focuses on backing independent developers. They’ve helped fund other cozy and wholesome titles you may be familiar with, and you can check them out here. Their support will allow us to expand the world, making the game bigger, better, and more delightful!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35149440/71284a722c97743035771cf61711438f8d3f5aac.png

You can expect more fruity friends who’ll provide additional favors and requests to hone your skills and foster the Grove’s community; a wider variety of Rot types and bosses to combat; additional natural resources to collect and further unlock the history of The Grove… and a few more surprises to make Garden Story the very best it can be. Because the team is working hard to expand Garden Story, we will also need more time than originally planned. The game will no longer be launching in Spring 2020 - we are now planning on releasing in 2021, and will let you know more details as soon as possible. We appreciate your patience, and promise it will be worth it! 

None of this would be possible without our amazing community. You uplift, inspire, and motivate us with your messages and comments as we continue to create Garden Story. So we wanted to say THANK YOU for supporting the team!  

If you’re curious to see more, we’ve refreshed our Steam page where you can see some of the updates and new content we’ve been working on; we can’t wait to hear what you think. One of the new additions? This updated teaser trailer!

[previewyoutube=ni0Phd7xH8Y;full][/previewyoutube]

If you have any additional questions not answered here, please feel free to find us on Discord or email us at hello@rosecitygames.com! 

Thanks, and talk soon!

Rose City Games + Picogram
